docs.title: API Docs - MNSCloud
docs.description: MNSCloud API documentation, OpenAPI contract, public clients, and integration boundaries.
docs.heading: One contract for public clients, agents, and edge services.
docs.lead: MNSCloud is built around an API-first control plane. Public repositories consume the API contract, while authorization, tenant scope, billing, routing ownership, policy decisions, and secret resolution stay server-side.

surfaces.title: Contribution model
surfaces.text: Pull Requests, CI, and maintainer review

docs.sectionTitle: What public clients can rely on.
docs.sectionText: Public integrations should depend on documented API behavior, request/response examples, authentication requirements, and tenant-aware headers. They must not duplicate private control-plane decisions outside the API.

cards.title: OpenAPI-first
cards.text: Endpoints are organized by product hierarchy so developers can find VoIP, Hosting, Monitoring, Cyber Security, and other modules consistently.

cards.title: Safe examples
cards.text: Public examples use placeholders and documented fields only. Secrets, customer data, production topology, and provider credentials stay out of public repositories.

cards.title: Governed changes
cards.text: API-facing changes are reviewed before merge. Public clients follow the API contract; the control plane remains the source of truth for authority and policy.

docs.ctaTitle: Build integrations on the contract, not on private assumptions.

developers.governanceText: Contributions enter through Pull Requests, with security checks, code ownership, and CI. MNSCloud may sponsor, pay, contract, or hire contributors when their work shows strong value, but paid work requires explicit written agreement.
developers.boundaryText: Public repositories contain clients, agents, installers, website code, and edge connectors. The core API, database schema, tenant policy, billing logic, routing authority, and secret resolution remain in the private control plane.
developers.ctaTitle: Build with us without weakening the platform boundary.

security.title: Security - MNSCloud
security.heading: Security is a control-plane responsibility.
security.lead: MNSCloud public clients and connectors are designed to be auditable. They do not carry server-side secrets, permanent provider credentials, database credentials, or hidden authorization bypasses.

cards.title: API authority
cards.text: Authorization, tenant scope, billing, policy, routing ownership, and secrets remain API-side.

cards.title: Outbound agents
cards.text: Remote management flows are initiated by agents to the API, reducing exposed management ports.

cards.title: Public boundary
cards.text: Public repositories use placeholders and documented contracts, not customer data or private topology.

security.ctaTitle: Review security posture before exposing infrastructure.
